dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 14, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Cubs Shut Down Cardinals Behind Seiya Suzuki's Homer**

The Chicago Cubs blanked the St. Louis Cardinals 3-0, with Seiya Suzuki powering the offense with a home run and three RBIs. Suzuki's 21st home run of the season came on a fly ball to left center field, scoring two runs. On the mound, Matthew Liberatore pitched 5.1 innings, striking out six and allowing two earned runs for the Cardinals. Clay Holmes earned the win for the Cubs.

**Reds Edge Marlins 1-0 in Low-Scoring Affair**

The Cincinnati Reds edged the Miami Marlins 1-0, behind Chase Burns' dominant 7.0 innings of shutout baseball. Burns struck out eight and allowed four hits, earning the win. Eugenio Suárez doubled home a run for the Reds in the top of the fifth inning.

**Pirates Pound Red Sox 8-4**

The Pittsburgh Pirates pounded the Boston Red Sox 8-4, with Rafael Flores Jr. leading the way with three hits and two RBIs. Flores Jr. also homered for the Pirates. Bubba Chandler pitched 5.0 innings, striking out five and allowing two earned runs, earning the win.

**White Sox Top Tigers 9-5 Behind Miguel Vargas' Homer**

The Chicago White Sox defeated the Detroit Tigers 9-5, behind Miguel Vargas' two-home run, three-RBI outing. Vargas' 27th home run of the season came on a fly ball to left center field. José Urquidy earned the win for the White Sox.

**Mets Shut Down Nationals 4-1**

The New York Mets shut down the Washington Nationals 4-1, behind Francisco Lindor's home run and two RBIs. Lindor's fifth home run of the season came on a fly ball to right center field. Jonathan Pintaro earned the win for the Mets.

**Padres Edge Guardians 7-5**

The San Diego Padres edged the Cleveland Guardians 7-5, behind a strong team effort. Nathaniel Lowe homered for the Guardians, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Padres' offense.

**Orioles Top Rays 6-5 in Walk-Off**

The Baltimore Orioles edged the Tampa Bay Rays 6-5, in a walk-off victory. Gunnar Henderson led the Orioles with four hits and two RBIs, including a home run.

**Diamondbacks Shut Down Braves 2-0**

The Arizona Diamondbacks shut down the Atlanta Braves 2-0, behind Chris Sale's 6.0 innings of shutout baseball. Sale struck out nine and allowed one earned run, but took the loss. Tim Tawa homered for the Diamondbacks.

**Blue Jays Top Yankees 3-1**

The Toronto Blue Jays edged the New York Yankees 3-1, behind Alejandro Kirk's home run and two RBIs. Kirk's fifth home run of the season came on a fly ball to right center field. Shane Bieber earned the win for the Blue Jays.

**Astros Top Mariners 10-7**

The Houston Astros topped the Seattle Mariners 10-7, behind Christian Walker's home run and three RBIs. Walker's 23rd home run of the season came on a fly ball to left field.

**Royals Edge Angels 7-6**

The Kansas City Royals edged the Los Angeles Angels 7-6, behind Jac Caglianone's home run and five RBIs. Caglianone's home run came on a fly ball to left center field.

**Athletics Top Rangers 8-3**

The Oakland Athletics topped the Texas Rangers 8-3, behind Jeff McNeil's four hits and three RBIs. McNeil's 15th double of the season came on a ground ball to right field.

**Dodgers Top Brewers 3-1**

The Los Angeles Dodgers edged the Milwaukee Brewers 3-1, behind Yoshinobu Yamamoto's 6.0 innings of one-run baseball. Yamamoto struck out nine and allowed one earned run, earning the win.

**Rockies Top Giants 5-2**

The Colorado Rockies edged the San Francisco Giants 5-2, behind a strong team effort. Zac Veen homered for the Rockies, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Giants' offense.
